# Web 4 — pay-policy/1, the agentic internet as open protocols
# pay-policy/1 is a vendor-neutral payment-policy format and a pure allow / deny / escalate evaluator for agents that spend — it sits over any rail and answers one question: given a policy and a proposed payment, may it go, must it stop, or must a person decide.
# The human front door to the stack: the map, the principles, and how a protocol joins.
# No repository on the map is public or launched today; this site makes zero external requests.

## Pages
- https://agentelabs.github.io/agentpay/ — the pitch and the nine-layer table, rendered from stack.json.
- https://agentelabs.github.io/agentpay/stack/ — every layer, its question, its repositories and its status.
- https://agentelabs.github.io/agentpay/principles/ — the five refusals the estate builds by.
- https://agentelabs.github.io/agentpay/joining/ — the five-rung ladder a protocol climbs to become a standard.
- https://agentelabs.github.io/agentpay/why/ — the argument for the stack, layer by layer.
- https://agentelabs.github.io/agentpay/faq/ — six honest answers, with FAQPage structured data.

## Machine surfaces (byte copies of their sources)
- https://agentelabs.github.io/agentpay/.well-known/stack.json — the web4/1 machine twin of the map.
- https://agentelabs.github.io/agentpay/.well-known/flashyos.json — the flashyos/1 mesh handshake, derived from the AAO charter.
- https://agentelabs.github.io/agentpay/.well-known/flashyos-charter.json — the AAO charter this org is provisioned from.
- https://agentelabs.github.io/agentpay/.well-known/directory.json — this org's directory/1 node.

The machine twin is maintained at https://github.com/AgenteLabs/agentpay; this repository is https://github.com/AgenteLabs/agentpay.
